verdict.rationale: Anthropic's rate-limits docs cover requests per minute (RPM) and tokens per minute (TPM), and include standard per-tier limit tables. They also explain enforcement, e.g. 60 RPM may be enforced as 1 request per second, and limits are viewable per account at /settings/limits. That covers the units and the tier dimensions of the story. Missing for 10: no evidence documenting what a 429 response looks like (status body, error type, retry-after or rate-limit headers), no explicit description of how an account moves up tiers, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits — requests and tokens per unit time, how tiers scale, and what a 429 looks like — before I hit them in production
